items.body: PK=EP#<endpointId> SK=EVT#<eventId> | type, body (exact signed JSON), createdAt, expiresAtEpoch
items.attempt: PK=EP#<endpointId> SK=ATT#<isoTs>#<eventId>#<attempt> | eventId, status (http code or 0), ok, durationMs, error, responseSnippet (≤ 1 KB), expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: dashboard log: Query PK=EP#e AND begins_with(SK, 'ATT#') ScanIndexForward=false
replay: GetItem PK=EP#e SK=EVT#<eventId>, re-enqueue the stored body
_design.why: write-heavy append log (every attempt), read by endpoint, expiring after 30 days - no reason to bloat Postgres with it
